local_verdict_reason: Correctness PASS. Both primary probe shapes have parent and candidate same-binary PASS and show stable regression: 1x32768 +7.50% (clean pairs all favP) and 1x16384 +8.11% (6/6 favP). 8x8192 near-neutral does not rescue. Root cause: vcadd mode=0 cannot reduce more than 64 FP32 to one value per call, so the vector-output swap needs two WholeReduceSum calls per tile (2 vcadds) vs the parent's one vcadd + handoff chain; the extra vector dispatch costs more than the removed V/S+get_acc_val+S_MTE3 chain. The pure one-call primitive swap is not achievable on this hardware; the adapter makes it a net loss.
architecture_conclusion: FIFTH reduction-structure variant refuted (V001 fold, V002 tree, V003 short-span, V004 binned single-stage, V005 primitive swap). Every reorganization of the per-call reduce loses or stays neutral: the parent's ReduceSum (one vcadd to acc + scalar round-trip) is near-optimal on dav-2201. Reduction structure/spans/primitive axis is exhausted on FROZEN_R31B_V011.
